LanguageData.RI_DaoThunderStorm.label: Ascension War
LanguageData.RI_DaoThunderStorm.description: A cultivator who had reached the perfection of the Earth Immortal realm began their ascension. A torrent of Qi poured down from the sky into a wave that swept across the land, stirring the clouds and causing countless bolts of lightning to crash down upon the earth.\n\nThese celestial phenomena were unmistakeable and attracted countless cultivators desperate to interrupt the ascension of a new immortal and seize their fortune for themselves.
LanguageData.RI_DaoThunderStorm.letterText: Thunder echoes across the entire planet, as the heavens and earth are torn asunder. A storm is imminent.
